marker_reviews.reason: This dynamic SELECT is the pre-replacement emptiness refusal for the three obsolete ColdLion production-history tables prod_history_line, prod_history_component and prod_history_last_lookup. It only reads whether each surviving table holds a row; it writes nothing, creates nothing and drops nothing. If any of them is non-empty the migration raises and stops before any replacement statement runs, so the statement leaves no post-apply catalog or row state that a hash-bound durable check could read back.

These three dynamic statements only set access posture on the rebuilt ColdLion production-history tables: enable row level security, revoke every privilege from public, anon and authenticated, and grant to service_role. They insert, update and delete no rows, so there is no row, key or typed count a row-count check could observe, and the sidecar check kinds available here cannot read pg_class.relrowsecurity or a grant. The posture they produce is asserted instead by the repository contract test supabase/tests/coldlion_prod_history_contracts.sql, which fails if any of prod_history_line, prod_history_component or prod_history_last_lookup lacks row security or still carries an application-role grant.
